dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge characterized by a smooth, continuous spline from the dorsal ridge to a posteriorly oriented apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse morphological shape; approximately 115-degree interior angle between leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin, approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Distinctly convex melon with a smooth semi-circular profile visible on the dorsal-anterior boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a visible pixel length approximately equal to the melon's vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Defined inflection point at the melon-rostrum junction with an interior angle of approximately 130 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-reflectance/depigmented patch is visible at the extreme apex of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, tapered pectoral fin visible on the lower ventral-lateral plane; clear gape line extending posteriorly towards the eye region.
